name: mysql-8.0-cte-window
query:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT id, status, total, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY total DESC) AS rnk
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id < 100
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3
UNION ALL
SELECT id, status, total, 0 FROM orders WHERE customer_id > 19950

        -> Filter: (ranked.rnk <= 3)  (cost=0.345..114 rows=330)
            -> Table scan on ranked  (cost=2.5..2.5 rows=0)
                -> Materialize CTE ranked  (cost=0..0 rows=0)
                    -> Window aggregate: rank() OVER (PARTITION BY orders.`status` ORDER BY orders.total desc ) 
                        -> Sort: orders.`status`, orders.total DESC  (cost=446 rows=990)
                            -> Index range scan on orders using orders_customer_id_idx over (customer_id < 100), with index condition: (orders.customer_id < 100)  (cost=446 rows=990)
    -> Stream results  (cost=225 rows=500)
        -> Index range scan on orders using orders_customer_id_idx over (19950 < customer_id), with index condition: (orders.customer_id > 19950)  (cost=225 rows=500)
